description: Puente. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Desarrollo Urbano - IDU. Estructura que se construye principalmente en obstáculos naturales como ríos, quebradas, depresiones del terreno y en obstáculos artificiales: canales, vías, infraestructura urbana; con el fin de comunicar dos puntos.Tiene como categorías; Vehicular: Infraestructura vial conectante destinada principalmente al uso de vehículos. Peatonal: espacio urbano donde el tránsito vehicular está prohibido, prevaleciendo la circulación de peatones. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Desarrollo Urbano - IDU. Its tags are Puente, Transporte. It offers 10 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-08-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
